raw_response:
I have farmed for a long time, so I will keep my land in the pattern I trust most. My main system is still wheat-maize because it fits my land, my water from the well, and the work rhythm my family can manage. I will put most of the 12 mu into the wheat-maize rotation, and I will keep a smaller piece for cotton because cotton still gives me a way to spread risk and use my experience. I will not chase very high input use, but I will not farm too lightly either, because I want stable yield more than gambling on either low cost or high output. For wheat and maize, I will use better seed, enough fertilizer, and several irrigations because water is available. For cotton, I will also use improved seed, but I will manage fertilizer and spraying more carefully because cotton needs more pest watching and more hand attention. I will use rotary tillage on most fields because it is practical for my scale and easier to manage across the year. My goal is steady production, manageable labor, and lower risk across all crops.
